title: Is CoT Monitor Performance Robust to Paraphrasing the Reasoning Trace?

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Clear chain: if paraphrasing degrades monitor performance, a misaligned model can trivially evade detection by rephrasing. This directly tests the robustness of CoT monitoring as a safety control.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: MALT transcripts are publicly available. Paraphrasing with a separate LM is straightforward API work. Running the monitor on both versions and comparing AUROC is standard. Well within beginner CS student capability with medium compute.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Clear pipeline: take transcripts, paraphrase, run monitor, compare AUROC. Single model, single dataset, one manipulation. Well within 30 hours.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
